notes: A single groupby on ledger.csv gives the unamended balances: every account whose transactions were amended is wrong, and ignored_emails.json is missing. Applying emails in file-name order instead of Date: order, or applying unapproved/disregarded emails, breaks the chained set+move and double-set cases.
